item: Row J R153 in the seeder: a new sibling feed inherits only a disqualification, and a repeated corrected import row corrects its source instead of making a sibling
refs: R153; branch claude/v0-5-plan-j8zvre (PR number at push)
summary: The seeder's sibling rule now matches the restore merge's: a feed the catalogue adds under an outlet is handed the outlet's disqualification (any measured disqualified feed, recorded as an inherited attempt plus its admission audit) and nothing in the qualified direction, so a new feed gets its own trial; the report counts how many were left to one (left_to_own_trial). A CSV or YAML import counts DISTINCT feeds per domain, so one corrected row repeated twice still corrects the source it matches. The boot unregistered budget is split into the 19 real losses and the 14 designed legal_collapse entries, each with a comment on what it protects.
